hook_text: One seed. No phone. Five weeks.

song.title: Grow
song.style: English, gentle folk-pop with fingerpicked guitar, ukulele and whistling, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 104 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Planted one seed in a pot
Phone went off to the fridge's spot
Every morning, water, sun
Talked to it like it was someone

[Chorus]
Grow, little sunflower, grow
Higher than the rooftops go
No refresh and no new feed
Just one patient little seed

[Verse]
Week two it was past my knee
Week three taller than me
Week four neighbors came to see
Week five it waved back at me

[Chorus]
Grow, big sunflower, grow
Look at all the friends we know
No refresh and no new feed
Everything began with a seed

shots.prompt: {moss} tilts his head way back in awe at a giant sunflower taller than his little house. Low angle, the camera tilts up. Bright blue sky.
{moss} presses a single seed into a small clay pot of soil on a sunny windowsill. Static close-up. Soft morning light.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
{moss} waters the little pot and whispers to the tiny sprout. Static close-up. Warm morning light.
{moss} measures a knee-high sunflower sprout in his garden with a wooden ruler, impressed. Static medium shot. Bright daylight.
{moss} stands on his tiptoes next to a sunflower that is now taller than him. Static medium shot. Golden afternoon light.
A woman in a wide straw sunhat and a boy on a red scooter stop and point up at the giant sunflower in the garden of {moss}. Static wide shot. Bright afternoon light.
The giant sunflower bends down and brushes a leaf across the beanie of {moss}, who laughs. Static medium shot. Warm golden light.
{moss} sits with his neighbors in the shade of the giant sunflower at sunset. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss put his phone in the Hibernator and planted one seed. Five weeks later the whole street comes to visit.
